description: This PHP class defines validation logic for the HTML attribute 'lang', ensuring that the language code conforms to RFC 3066/RFC 4646 standards. It processes language subtags, normalizing case and validating subtag length and characters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Lang
classes.description: A class that validates the 'lang' HTML attribute for correctness based on language code standards.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a language code string according to RFC standards, returning the normalized code or false if invalid.
